violation_type.title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids (26 TAC §746.3415(7))
violation_type.short_title: Employee Handwashing After Handling or Cleaning Bodily Fluids
violation_type.typical_finding: During the monitoring inspection a caregiver wiped two children's noses and did not wash their hands. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was asked to wash their hands, and did, and the expectations for hand washing after wiping noses was explained.

finding_variants.text: During the monitoring inspection a caregiver wiped two children's noses and did not wash their hands. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was asked to wash their hands, and did, and the expectations for hand washing after wiping noses was explained.

A caregiver was observed wiping a child's nose and then failed to wash their hands. The caregiver then went around the room helping other children with their activity and touching the puzzle pieces with the used tissue still in their hand.

It was observed during the inspection two caregivers wiping children's noses and not washing their hands in between each nose cleaning. This was corrected at inspection. When caregiver was asked to wash their hands after cleaning a child's nose.
During the investigation inspection it was observed that noses were being wiped and the caregiver was not washing their hands after.

Staff were observed at inspection cleaning multiple children's noses and not washing their hands afterwards. Additionally, a staff member cleaned spit up off the carpet and did not wash their own hands afterwards.
A caregiver was observed wiping a child's nose and was observed to not have washed their hands afterwards.
